description_en: Updates the information about a live package channel group including its description
description_zh: 更新实时打包服务中的频道组信息，包括描述
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-live-package-channel-group --group-name channel-group-1 --description This_is_a_channel_group. --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageChannelGroup

parameters.help_en: The channel group name. It can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The channel group description. It can be up to 1,000 characters in length
parameters.name: description
